Because this document is a results note rather than a re-analysis with model-based inference, it does not specify whether weights were applied at the computation stage; users should follow the TALIS database documentation when reproducing the figures.

The reported outcomes are descriptive indicators (e.g., teacher age and gender composition, experience in non-teaching roles, perceived ability to adapt teaching to cultural diversity, inclusion of students with special education needs, social and emotional learning support, technology/AI use, induction/mentoring, professional learning needs and barriers, instructional autonomy and decision-making, collaboration and relationships, teaching profession status, employment terms, sources of teacher stress, and professional outcomes such as meeting lesson aims and well-being).
